turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Could you send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used to order? I’ll check whether the print is eligible for a return and refund.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.
I’ve passed your return and refund request for order SC-3744 to a colleague, who will take over from here. The return and refund haven’t been approved yet.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer claire.fontaine@example.com wants to return the print from SC-3744 for a refund because they ordered the wrong size. Return policy check flagged large_refund; staff review needed. No return request filed.
